text:
maya.r: Quick update — LyraMed signed a 24-month renewal and approved our AWS Marketplace ISV listing for the Private connector + Dedicated pool. Deal ~ $480k ARR. They migrated their clinical-inference pipelines into a single Private VPC and enabled BYOK/HSM. Huge thanks to @trent_z and @sophia_ops for the migration and compliance work. :tada:

trent_z: Migration summary: consolidated 5 endpoints into a 2-node autoscaled pool with reserved headroom, enabled envelope encryption to the customer's HSM, and applied int4 + mixed-precision path for heavier models. Early metrics: ~42% token-cost reduction and ~27% P95 latency improvement on their triage model. I'll upload perf charts to the case draft.

luis_sales: Sales note: customer added a Professional Services add-on for model tuning. They requested a joint case study and an exec quote for the PR. cc @ben_legal for marketplace terms and attribution.

sophia_ops: Runbook + rollback are in Notion: https://notion.redwood/LyraMed-migration-runbook. Canary rollout used staged traffic 7/20/30/43 over 72h, no user-facing downtime. Small hiccup: certificate rotation hit a race on one node causing ~0.9% 5xxs for 12m; fixed by reloading the sidecar certs and increasing preStop timeout. Logged the root cause and resolution.

ben_legal: Reviewing marketplace MSA and the BYOK addendum. One minor logging-retention clause to update; will upload the redline by EOD tomorrow.

marketplace-bot: AWS Marketplace listing pushed to staging. Preview: https://aws.marketplace/staging/lyramed-redwood (staging). Please verify description and support contact.

lyramed-bot: Customer-approved quote: "Redwood's Private connector gave us enterprise controls and dramatic cost reductions so we could safely scale clinical inference." — LyraMed Head of Platform

press-bot: Created PR task PR-5278 for the case study + press assets. Marketing: want final one-line metrics and the customer quote to publish.

luis_sales: Can marketing draft the joint announcement next Wednesday? Ops: please prepare a 1-slide summary of the migration lessons for internal channels. Eng-ML: can you add the quant config we used to the Redwood Optimize recipes?

sophia_ops: Action items noted: (1) add cert rotation mitigation steps to ops-runbook, (2) publish canary traffic plan template, (3) add short postmortem-lite slides. Also leaving a rollback command in the runbook: `redwoodctl cluster rollback --cluster lyramed-prod --to-tag v2025-07-15`.

trent_z: I'll add the exact quant/compile flags and an example config snippet to the case draft.

maya.r: Thank you everyone — Marketing/PR please hold until legal signs off and customer approves logo. Tiny celebration: bagels in the kitchen tomorrow 9:30. :bagel: :coffee:

ben_legal: Uploaded MSA redline and the signed BYOK appendix to /legal/marketplace/lyramed.

press-bot: Scheduling staging -> production publish for PR-5278 on 2025-05-02T13:00:00Z.

maya.r: Great work team. I'll send a short exec summary with ROI numbers after we finalize the customer-approved assets.
